title: rename lines vs a mismatching ---/+++ pair in a diff --git header: one block, E209
notes: §12 item 1: after the completed rename pair, the pair '--- a/a.txt' / '+++ b/c.txt' belongs to the rename header because the `---` path (a.txt after prefix removal) equals `rename from` (§4.1 HEADER). The block keeps diff --git a/a.txt b/c.txt, which agrees with ---/+++ (no E202); check 3 of §6.3.2: 'rename to b.txt' differs from the +++ path c.txt -> E209. There is no second block, so no E608.
